method.geometry: the R9 alpha's own 0.5 crossing per row (rows 198-357)
method.sectors: 48 equal-angle longitudes of the layer's own outline: x_t(y) = x_mid(y) + sin(phi_t) half_width(y), phi_t = -90 + (t + 0.5) 3.75 deg; t = 0 the left limb (window side), 23/24 the axis, 47 the right limb
method.profile: per sector and row the mean L* over a box of one pleat period (11 px: the paper's row autocorrelation peaks at 11 px, r = 0.79, 60 rows) centred on x_t(y); paper pixels only, >= 6 px
method.paper: alpha 255, rows >= 201, the collar apart (|x - 1676.5| <= 9, y <= 203), eroded 5 x 5, clay z >= OPEN_Z + 0.004 (R6's measure mask); 24654 px
method.smooth: cubic B-spline, 4 segments (5 knots) over each sector's measured rows, least squares
method.step: (mean of the 3 rows below a row boundary) - (mean of the 3 rows above), on the residual; |change| > 1.0 L* and the largest within +-3 rows
method.curves: steps of one sign linked across neighbouring sectors (|dy| <= 4 rows); a boundary curve = a chain over >= 3 sectors
method.r6_lines: R6's clay latitude lines (work-r6/fix-r6.json pendant-v2.rings.tiers, all rounds): [0.0354, 0.0688, 0.0875, 0.1042, 0.125, 0.1437] m; the distance is along the pixel column, where fix_r6.latlong_map's z crosses the line
